group.title: Workshop quote and invoice
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Workshop quotation
Training fee: NT$750 per participant. Groups of ten or more receive a 10% discount on training fees. Room rental is a fixed NT$2,000 and is not discounted. No tax or service fee will be added to the quoted charges. A deposit of NT$3,000 is deducted from the final amount due.

DOCUMENT 2 — Booking confirmation and billing statement
Thank you for confirming twelve participants for the communication workshop on July 9. We have received your NT$3,000 deposit. No additional participants have been added.

Billing statement
Training: 12 × NT$750 = NT$9,000
Room rental: NT$2,000
Less deposit: NT$3,000
Balance due: NT$8,000

DOCUMENT 3 — Organizer’s email
The participant count and deposit are correct, but the invoice appears to omit the discount in your quotation. Please send a corrected invoice before we arrange the balance payment.
group.passageZh:
文件一——工作坊報價
訓練費每人新臺幣七百五十元。十人以上團體的訓練費享九折。場租固定兩千元，不打折。報價所列費用不另加稅或服務費。三千元訂金會自最後應付金額扣除。

文件二——工作坊預約確認與帳單
感謝確認七月九日溝通工作坊共十二人參加。已收到三千元訂金，沒有追加參加者。

帳單明細
訓練費：12 × 750 = 9,000 元
場租：2,000 元
扣除訂金：3,000 元
應付餘額：8,000 元

文件三——主辦人電子郵件
參加人數及訂金正確，但帳單似乎漏列報價中的折扣。請寄送更正後的帳單，我們再安排支付餘額。
